admissionInfo.text: ENGL and MATH QL courses must have a grade C or higher. GPA of 3.0 or higher with no grade lower than a C in content area courses. Completion of all General Education requirements and 70% of content area courses. Pass LiveScan Criminal Background Check. Requirements by the Department of Languages: a) Complete the Spanish controlled writing sample, b) Complete a video of you teaching a lesson in Spanish, c) ACTFL OPI test with a score of Advanced Low or higher.
